definition.label: Gaussian-rank preprocessing for V25 correction
definition.formula: On6k correction only: median impute, QuantileTransformer100quantiles normal output, quadratic3-knot spline, scale; missing indicators+employment; original offset BCE+L2.003 and shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
definition.rationale: Extreme historical financial measurements affect boundary knots and basis scaling. Train-reference ranks test robustness to outlier magnitudes without fitting on test distributions. Same18 inputs and frozen context.

definition.label: P-spline-inspired coefficient roughness correction
definition.formula: V25 head objective meanBCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.03/2||D2*(beta_spline/scale)||^2; difference penalty within each numeric spline block; shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
definition.rationale: Global L2 does not distinguish smooth financial relationships from oscillating residual corrections. Add coefficient-difference regularization while keeping the18 inputs and90-coefficient design. Quantile knots differ from canonical equally spaced P-splines; do not claim an exact continuous curvature penalty.

definition.label: Stabilized Jeffreys-information correction
definition.formula: Minimize meanBCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2-.5/n*logdet(X^T*W(beta)*X/n+.0001I); original V25 design and shrink.5; original75:25 spline fusion
definition.rationale: Sparse combinations of employment/missingness and repayment evidence can bias correction coefficients. Test a stabilized Firth-inspired information penalty; addedridge andL2 mean this is not exact classical Firth logistic regression. No transfer of published performance claims.

definition.label: Laplace predictive uncertainty for original V25 head
definition.formula: Fit original V25 beta; Sigma=(X^T*W*X+n*.003*diag(0,1,...)+1e-6I)^-1; eta=zK+.5Xbeta; v=.25*diag(X*Sigma*X^T); pK~=sigmoid(eta/sqrt(1+pi*v/8)); original75:25 spline fusion
definition.rationale: V189 partial pooling gives a small gain without more input dimensions. Extend reliability to the head posterior: high-leverage applicants receive more predictive integration. Approximate Laplace uncertainty conditions on encoder/prior, excludes Kumo and model-selection uncertainty.

definition.label: Laplace uncertainty for stable9 local-context correction
definition.formula: UseV19627-input local-context head; calculate conditional Laplace coefficient covariance and logistic-normal predictive approximation asV202; original75:25 spline fusion
definition.rationale: Test whether uncertainty is especially useful for the higher-dimensional spectral head rather than the compact original18. Same formula and conditional caveats asV202; compareV196 for the specific effect.
